description: This file contains unit tests for DynamoDB storage operations using the xUnit testing framework. It tests CRUD operations, conditional updates, and concurrency controls on DynamoDB through a manager class.

classes.name: DynamoDBStorageTests
classes.description: Unit test class for DynamoDB storage operations, verifying create, read, update, delete, and concurrency.

methods.name: DynamoDBStorageTests
methods.description: Constructor initializing test fixture and setting up partition key.

methods.name: GenerateNewData
methods.description: Generates a new test data item with unique identifiers.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_CreateItemAsync
methods.description: Tests creation of a new DynamoDB item with conditional check to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_UpsertItemAsync
methods.description: Tests inserting or updating items (upsert) with concurrency control via ETag.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_DeleteItemAsync
methods.description: Tests deletion of a DynamoDB item.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_ReadSingleTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Tests reading a single item from DynamoDB.

methods.name: DynamoDBDataManager_ReadAllTableEntryByPartitionAsync
methods.description: Tests querying all items under a specific partition key.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of key attributes for a DynamoDB item.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of attribute values for a DynamoDB item, optionally including key attributes.
